items.note: States the eight-row schedule, y<-y+x for arbitrary scratch, and (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with restored auxiliaries; sub-steps follow the proof (net change (JV+RG)x, bit and complex coefficients, three stages). Neighbour and wire counts (eq:bit-wire-count) are not given, but they are not part of the lemma's proof.
States D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and the per-route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}; derives it by the paper's invariant argument (sources, edges, gate commutation by linearity).

Bilinear forms, triple-line orthogonality, terminal labels, only-decreasing central 3->4 edges losing h, telescoping to Wm-2N+2L, orthonormal residual bases and the ratios 100/539, 101/539 are all correct. The gate-label table (eq:motif-labels: A(x)F on X centre, B(x)F on Y centre, central wire losing P(x)F) and the per-edge residual table are not given, so the key claim that every edge is nested with losses confined to the centre is asserted (S1.3.3.4 quotes the lemma) rather than derived; only the side-wire inclusion is shown.

Projection assignment, -P_{U_a} at X_a sources, endpoint identity I_m, rank of P_V-P_U equal to dimension change, the N exceptional rank-one source edges, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m all match the proof.

Phase frames, one kernel aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector and s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m are stated and derived along the paper's route (weight additivity mod 4, odd weight, Hadamard conjugation). The endpoint part (zero label gives I, full label gives C^{(x)m}, the X_a->Y_a pair gives C^{-1} on the 27 support coordinates, fixed by Z and i^{27k}) is only alluded to in S1.5.1.5, not derived.

Gives L<N/2, the deficits N-2L_b and 2N-2L_c, the exact eta_b, eta_c, the comparison with 20*2^{-50}, log m<20 and m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20*2^{-50}), hence s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, as at 1319-1346.

Both lemmas are stated with their content (digit permutations, moves, split/merge, cyclic row split; controlled shift with b^{O(1)} offset and fixed rational units). S1.2 names the split-at-Q-a mechanism, but neither lemma is derived through sub-steps.

A=E_1 Pi E_2 by topmost-row rightmost-pivot elimination, lower-triangular factors in O(V) by descending-order updates, and each one of Pi as one interchange between two controlled updates, giving exactly a interchanges, as in the paper.

Cyclic row split into W role streams of volume V/W, shear frames giving H<-H+D on every row, the three-update interchange, s recursive calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric sum in both cases a<=1 and a>1, and the fixed-tape parking schedule all follow the proof.

Exact statement of the lemma; the derivation borrows high digits as rows, pads to a multiple of W^k, splits the width in base m with a_j<m and m^k<me, and pads binary ranges to [q^e], as in the proof.
Conjugation by P_M with only invertibility used, the inverse child identity, at most m(m-1)+3m row additions, s_c children on e/m axes, and H_0^{(x)D}=b^D S_D C^{(x)D} S_D all match the paper.

Eight controlled +-1 updates, packed cyclic shifts correct off the guard set 10<=g<=2^{K-1}-11, delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, T_0 S_0^{-1} permuting B, sort-based repair, and the family cost O(V(L^tau+1)). The separate XOR at the top position j_{f-1} is not mentioned, a small omission.

Rows from the first q_0 chunks, whole rows to roles giving V/W children, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1), leaves below d^{1/2}, internal sum with ratio a/m^lambda, leaves e^sigma u^{1-sigma}, and the base-m piece sum to O(d^{lambda'}) all follow the paper.

Layer statement with K=floor(d^c), D<=d, one truncation and error <sqrt2 2^{-p}; guard-width argument via A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, depth 8B^2 d^{12}, Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{20})=o(p), and the row-sum-one disk argument match the paper.

Character cancellation by index shift, decimation in frequency, B_t F_t^- and F_t^+ B_t^{-1}, grouping into H then J_E, prefix moves, O(p/K) chunk exchanges, simultaneous rounds, monomial multiplication, single truncation per round and error sqrt2 l 2^{-p} all follow the paper.
B_0=2^{4p}, four products with the established multiplier, the separation |h_j|<B_0/2, centered residues with carries, and O(rp log(rp)) cost match the lemma and proof.
Retained LB order with P(LBu,LBv)=LBP(u,v), scaling by M, error sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p} from 3delta+eta, and the stated cost all match.

Statement matches lem:no-sort-resampling and lem:tensor-resampling; the derivation uses N=CTD with ||N-I||<2^{-alpha^2 theta}<1/2, A=S/2, B_0=D'J'C, the left inverse DN^{-1}C, permutations kept in the identity, tensoring, and O(d^2) axis exposures.

Both identities are stated correctly with the chirp, the periodicity condition and S=prod s_i; S3.4 sketches the reason (t_i a unit mod s_i, RF^+R=F^+), but the steps are single infer steps without a derivation of the chirp coefficient computation.
Fixed constants, sizes, prime intervals with eta=1/(4d), T/2<S<T via Bernoulli, alpha^4 theta_i>3db>=p, and machine-computed primes all match the paper.
Isomorphism argument, the triangular formula b_i, updates in order i=d..1 keeping padding zero, prefix-controlled shifts, and O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)) axis reordering follow the paper.

Twist isomorphism, the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j, and M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T are stated correctly; the computed version's twist errors are not given and there is no sub-derivation.

Source transform with exact counterpart 2^gamma B_0 Q F_t A = RF_s, the conjugated opposite procedure, and the six steps with the two scalings by S and 2^{2b+4}S match the paper; the input digit scale 2^{-b-2} is implicit only through the 2^{2b+4} factor.
Error chain E_ring<5TL, chirp <8TL, E_s=9*2^gamma TL, E_w<28*2^gamma T^2 L, final 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2 with S<=T<2^b and gamma<=b/4, and carry propagation all match.

V=Tp, the seven margins with min g_2=2^{-181}=2kappa, the chunk-exchange source of the smallest margin, o(V) setup and exceptional sorting, log-power absorption and the schoolbook cutoff match the paper. The full per-row table of normalized costs is not reproduced, but the margins carry its content.

errors.says: Every nonzero edge residual contains a vector of norm one, so it is nondegenerate and nonalternating and therefore has an orthonormal basis.
errors.paper: Nondegeneracy of each residual comes from the orthogonal decompositions; the norm-one vector gives only nonalternation ('Each residual is nondegenerate by the decompositions above. Thus every nonzero residual is nonalternating.'). A norm-one vector does not imply nondegeneracy.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route throughout: scalar exchange network, frames, subspace labels and budget, the bit and complex interfaces with s<Wm and tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, the matrix shear and power-width recurrence to O(Vu^tau), the phase-frame layer recurrence to O(Vd^{lambda'}), then synthetic transforms, resampling, chirp, CRT, exact recovery and the cost table to O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}). It thins out in two places: the gate-label table that confines all label losses to the central 3->4 edges is asserted rather than shown, and the endpoint telescoping of the complex interface to C^{(x)m} (the 27-coordinate C^{-1} correction) is only alluded to.

steps.note: Three-element subsets of [100], a fixed linear network taking (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a) and restoring every auxiliary wire, and m as the dimension of F^{(x)3} with F=Q^{100} are present. N=binom(100,3)^3 and the explicit indexing of the banks by a in T^3 are not written out.
Common frame per gate commuting with the pointwise gate, D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and free intermediate frames so each edge costs only a frame change.
Nondegenerate subspace labels of F^{(x)3} of dimension m, comparable labels on every edge, only central 3->4 edges decreasing, each losing h=100. The gate-label table itself is not given.
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, and the N source edges with matrix 2P_{U_a} of rank one as the exceptions.
Sum of absolute changes Wm-2N+2L by telescoping, L as h times the number of central wires (Ich), and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L_b/N=100/539, L_c/N=101/539 below 1/2, deficit N-2L_b>0 so s_b<W_b m.
M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role (P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m on X_a), giving H<-H+D on every row including scratch rows.
A=E_1 Pi E_2, exactly a interchanges plus O(V) per edge, so s recursive calls per node.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20, hence F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: The plan reconstructs all nine steps of the central saving with their defining quantities: the fixed bank-exchange network, frames, nested labels losing only on central edges, rank equal to dimension change with N rank-one source exceptions, the budget s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, L/N<1/2, the endpoint identity, edges as rank-many recursive interchanges, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The thinnest points are the absent explicit N formula in C1 and the gate-label table behind C3.
